answer: Weight each identity only by edges crossing a committed min-cut from the honest core. A sybil cluster is an island whose umber interior the protocol never resolves, so it cannot see which aliases share a hand. A gale of self-issued vouchers inside that island counts for nothing; only links to distinct non-kin attesters cross the cut, and that inlet stays capped however large the cluster grows. Each outside attester locks a bond settlement burns on a correlated-fault proof. Growing N clones needs N outside attesters from a thin rivalrous pool, so marginal cost rises with N and never pools.
